results: On the court, the game modes show free shooting and Court Duel with the players present
Challenge and accept in the interface; the countdown starts play and each player is handed their own ball
The live scoreboard updates for both players
Conceding ends the duel; the rated result is recorded and both see their new rating
The database holds exactly the result the room computed
Rankings show the rules, the player’s record and history; newcomers are not ranked until 3 rated duels
